faqs.q: Who can apply for the Victims Support Scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme helps people who have suffered an injury as a result of a violent crime committed in NSW. Victims of modern slavery are also able to apply for support.

faqs.q: What kind of support is available?
faqs.a: The scheme may help with various needs depending on your specific situation.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about the scheme?
faqs.a: You can visit Victims Services or call one of the provided numbers during business hours for more information on the scheme, eligibility, and how to apply.
